# `placement` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/placement.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A placement (doc 03 §16 `Placement3D`, doc 12 §2.3, rank 54, the layout file of its carrier's space): a device,
or one of its functions, on a carrier at a pose relative to the carrier.

It stores no tag text (labels are `layout_label(placement)`, D-02) and no geometry: the footprint comes from the
part. A placement cannot outlive its device (delete policy cascade, EW-LAY-002) and keeps its carrier (forbid).

| File | `layout/<space>.jsonl` |

## Types

### CarrierRef

What a placement sits on (doc 12 §2.3 `CarrierRef`): `{"carrier": id}` or `{"surface": id}`. Piggy-back
mounting on another placement (1.0) is kept verbatim as `CarrierRef::Unknown`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A rail or duct.

   Shape: object { `carrier`: [`Uuid`](#uuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `carrier` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2). |

2. **Form 2**: The mounting surface itself.

   Shape: object { `surface`: [`Uuid`](#uuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `surface` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2). |

### PartRef

A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `copy` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`. |
| `variant` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | A variant key of the part. |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### Pose3

A pose (doc 05 §3.2): translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a unit quaternion in 10^-9. JSON Schema cannot express that q is unit (within 2.001 x 10^9 of 10^18 squared) and sign-normalised (w > 0, or the first non-zero component positive); the reader rejects both.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | array of (integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000)) (at least 4 item(s), at most 4 item(s)) | yes |  |  |
| `t` | array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 3 item(s), at most 3 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
